players.product: circuit protection (eFuses, TVS) and power semiconductors for datacenter power

quarterly_data.signal: 10-K fiscal 2025 results by segment: net sales $2,386.3 million, +8.9% from $2,190.8 million; Electronics segment $1,345.5 million (+13.4%), of which Electronics - Semiconductor $669,579 thousand ($615,372 thousand in 2024) and Electronics - Passive Products and Sensors $675,943 thousand ($571,401 thousand); Electronics segment operating income $220.1 million (+29.6%); Transportation $676.4 million (+0.6%); Industrial $364.4 million (+9.9%). Capital expenditures were $67.6 million. Littelfuse performs the majority of its own fabrication, fabricates semiconductor wafers for certain applications (with in-house epitaxy, die attach and wafer probe testing) and uses external wafer foundries and subcontracted test and assembly facilities for a portion of its semiconductor business.

quarterly_data.signal: 10-K backlog: the backlog of unfilled orders at December 27, 2025 was approximately $1,070.9 million, compared to $664.9 million at December 28, 2024, with the increase across all segments; substantially all the orders in backlog are scheduled for delivery in 2026.
quarterly_data.figure: backlog approximately $1,070.9 million at December 27, 2025 (vs $664.9 million); substantially all for 2026 delivery

quarterly_data.signal: 10-K customer concentration - Customer Arrow Electronics: sales to Arrow Electronics, reported in the Electronics, Transportation and Industrial segments, were 9.5% of consolidated net sales in 2025 (9.4% in 2024, 11.2% in 2023); no other single customer exceeded 10% in the last three years. Littelfuse sells directly to over 4,000 customers and distributors; approximately 65% of 2025 net sales were to customers outside the U.S., including approximately 24% to China.
